answer: Each agent locks a basalt-hard bond whose slashing risk grows with every identity it registers, so spinning up fake agents costs real capital per sybil. One concrete protocol: stake-weighted beacon attestation. A rotating lotus quorum then signs each epoch's beacon, and peers reject identities lacking independent bond history. Forgery therefore requires controlling a majority of bonded stake, making attacks economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
